title: Black Beauty
author: Anna Sewell
summary: A horse tells his own life story, from a kind country home through a series of owners, some gentle and some cruel. The book was written to encourage kinder treatment of working animals.
readIf: you want a classic told by an animal and mind being moved by how animals were treated.
skipIf: scenes of animal suffering and overwork are too upsetting.

pairings.reason: An animal story that treats its creatures seriously and does not shy from danger, with a bigger adventure.
A gentler children's classic about animals, with a lot of tenderness.
An animal classic with the cruelty removed and the comforts kept.
